origin.details: Uses ICU unescape. Recognized forms include \a, \b, \t, \n, \v, \e, \f, \r, quote, apostrophe, backslash, \uXXXX, \UXXXXXXXX, \xXX, octal \ooo, and \cX masked with 0x1F. An unknown letter drops the backslash. An ill-formed sequence warns and that string becomes NA. A result containing U+0000 raises embedded nul in string. A lone surrogate fails character conversion.
origin.value: A character vector. An ill-formed escape becomes NA, with a warning.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA. The backslashes are characters in the string, not Python escapes.

translation.details: Follows ICU u_unescapeAt. \u takes four hex digits and \U takes eight. \x takes one or two, or \x{...} with fewer than eight. Eight hex digits inside braces are ill-formed, because the brace check sees the last digit. A lead surrogate is joined with a following trail surrogate. An unknown letter such as \q becomes q. One bad sequence warns and sets that whole string to NA. U+0000 raises embedded nul in string. A lone surrogate raises the ICU unmappable-character error. An empty string stays empty.
translation.value: A list of strings. An ill-formed escape is NA.
